title: Understanding the Code Snippet
text: The code snippet `df[df['b'] $$==$$ 7]['a'].iloc[0]` is filtering the DataFrame `df` where the column 'b' equals $$7$$. Then, it selects the 'a' column from the filtered result and retrieves the first element using `iloc[0]`.

title: Filtering the DataFrame
text: Look at the DataFrame and identify which row has the value $$7$$ in column 'b'. This will help you understand which row is being selected.

title: Selecting the Column
text: Once you have the row where 'b' is $$7$$, check the value in column 'a' for that row. This is the value that will be returned by the code snippet.

title: Choose the Correct Value
text: What is the value of 'a' in the row where 'b' is 7?
